name: What happens during the final client walkthrough after detail work is complete?
description: During the final walkthrough, clients inspect the completed project with a project manager to confirm it meets expectations and note any remaining concerns.

mainEntity.name: What happens during the final client walkthrough after detail work is complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The final client walkthrough is a critical step where you inspect the completed project to ensure it meets your expectations and the agreed-upon specifications. During this walkthrough, Frasheski Construction's project manager will guide you through each area, highlighting the finished details and addressing any questions. This is your opportunity to point out any remaining concerns or areas that need minor adjustments, which are then noted and rectified before final handover.
